newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel awards US$150 mln mandate.
newsitem.headline: China Travel awards US$150 mln mandate.

text.p: China Travel Services Holdings Hong Kong Ltd has mandated five banks to arrange a US$150 million financing five-year facility, bankers said.
They said arrangers are Bankers Trust, Banque Indosuez, LTCB, Sanwa Bank and Sumitomo Bank.
For the first three years of the facility, it is a US commercial paper program/revolving credit facility combined, changing to a term loan for the last two years.
Therefore, the first three years of the facility could be on an unfunded basis to the syndicated banks if commercial paper is issued, or a funded basis if used as a revolving credit.
Pricing details are not yet available.
An underwriting group is being formed.
